entry.title: How TikTok Made Ponke a $300M Meme Coin
entry.summary: Ponke is a meme coin of a degenerate monkey who gambles and trades every day. The project’s social media presence is a key differentiating factor, especially its approach to TikTok and Instagram—sites ignored by most tokens.
